aggregate_verdict: Current successful model reviews are one Weak accept and one Borderline. Both view IGRE/TFR as novel and reproducible, but both keep the work at pilot/method-and-measurement status because independent human ratings, broader matched benchmarks, and system-level superiority evidence remain missing.
blocking_issues: No independent human expert ratings have been collected.
System-level empirical superiority over autonomous AI Scientist-v2 remains unproven.
Prospective evidence is small and includes mixed or negative benchmark outcomes despite positive controlled Max-Cut micro-pilots.
The model-only blind packet dry run is negative for ungated review-guided artifacts versus context controls.
Many results remain probes, smoke tests, model-routed reviews, or controlled micro-tasks.
claim_boundary: Model reviews are iteration evidence only. They do not replace independent human expert review, larger matched benchmark runs, or broad multi-researcher traces.
